# CodeNeat

> CodeNeat is a free, open-source code formatter extension for Visual Studio Code. One extension formats 41 languages through their real formatting engines, with a visual settings dashboard, a live before/after preview and format on save. 32 languages work with nothing else to install.

Key facts:

- Install: search "CodeNeat" in the VS Code Extensions view, or run `ext install PamalJayasinghe.codeneat`
- Price: free. Licence: Apache-2.0. Author: Pamal Jayasinghe
- Platforms: Windows, macOS and Linux (VS Code 1.90 or newer)
- Privacy: no account, no telemetry, no network requests; code is formatted on the user's computer
- Ready on install (32): JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, TSX, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Less, JSON, JSON with Comments, YAML, Markdown, MDX, Vue, Angular templates, GraphQL, XML, Python, Java, C, C++, C#, Go, PHP, Dart, SQL, Bash, Lua, TOML, Dockerfile, Protocol Buffers, LaTeX
- With the language's own formatter (9): Rust, Kotlin, Swift, Ruby, Scala, F#, PowerShell, R, Terraform
- Engines used: Prettier, Ruff, gofmt, clang-format, StyLua, shfmt, dart format, SQL Formatter, Taplo, dockerfmt and others
- Respects .editorconfig, .prettierrc, .clang-format and rustfmt.toml, and never modifies them
- Shortcut: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F (Windows, Linux) or Cmd+Option+Shift+F (macOS)
